parameters.apprise_url_plus: embys://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.user_secret }} }:${ customer_secrets.{{ params.password_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.host_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-emby` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Emby destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional Emby destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Emby destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Emby host

password_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Emby password

user_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Emby user
